snippet.title: The Division 2: Battle for Brooklyn DLC - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
"The Division 2: Battle for Brooklyn DLC is available on May 27th at 8am UTC, Let's head back to New York, agents! Check the link: https://ubi.li/mlp8v

Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 Battle for Brooklyn is a DLC for Tom Clancy’s The Division 2 and requires the base game to play."
